'''Tatooine''' is the 29th expansion of Star Wars CCG, published by Decipher in May 2001. It is 107 cards (54 Light Side and 53 Dark Side): 30 rares, 30 uncommons, 30 commons, 9 alternate-image cards, 6 rules cards, and 2 checklists. Black border. CardGuide numbering: 29th product (CardGuide lists 99 without rules/checklists).

It is the first Episode I expansion and mixes ''The Phantom Menace'' with Classic Trilogy Tatooine. Sold in 11-card packs (MSRP $3.29: 1 rare or alternate image plus mixed commons/uncommons) in 30-pack boxes.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]</ref>

== Print sheets ==
Rares, uncommons, and commons are 11&times;11 (121 cards). Commons and uncommons print on the same sheets. Each rare appears eight times; for each alternate-image rare, 2 of those 8 are the AI version (except [[Boonta Eve Podrace]], nine times per side).<ref name="encyc" />
